description:
Durable and Waterproof Synthetic Menu Printing

Upgrading your restaurant's visuals and marketing starts with a vibrant and appealing menu design. With synthetic menus, you can achieve this alongside unmatched durability and long-lasting usage. Made from sturdy synthetic material, this menu option is waterproof, tear-resistant, stain-proof, and fade-resistant. Synthetic menus are ideal for busy fast-food environments but are also used in fine dining and high-class restaurants.  

Design the perfect menu representing your food business and confidently showcase it to your customers through high-quality synthetic menu printing.

Custom Menu Printing With Flexible Folds and Strong Materials

Synthetic menus are made to last and look good. They are designed to withstand the wear and tear of everyday use, making them ideal for any food establishment. At Uprinting you can get the best of this menu option, from design to the final print. 

Waterproof menus in two sizes: 

The menu items are printed on a 10pt. synthetic material coming in two distinct sizes: 

  • 11 x 17” 
  • 5.5 x 17”  

Choose your folds: 

The menus can come as a standard flat menu or folding menus for different presentations. You can also choose the type of fold you prefer. 

  • Half fold 
  • Tri-fold 
  • Z-fold  

Printing options for waterpoof menus 

Print the menu options front and back, outside and inside, to maximize the space for your menus. If you have a smaller, exclusive selection of meals to showcase, you can also print one-sided menus. 


Synthetic Menu FAQs

Q: How durable are the synthetic menus?

Synthetic menus are known for their durability and resilience. While the synthetic material feels like thick paper, it is tear-resistant, waterproof, fade-resistant, and stain-proof. You can also use the material lamination-free, meaning you won’t have to worry about peeling and cracking.

Q: How do I clean waterproof menus?

We recommend cleaning with a dry cloth or mild soap and water.  Do not use abrasive, alcohol or chemical cleaners. 

Q: How long do these menus last?

Synthetic menus are made to last, and their lifespan is significantly longer than paper or cardstock. You can even extend its longevity through proper care and maintenance. 

Q: Can I customize the design on synthetic menus?

Of course! You can fully customize your synthetic menus with your restaurant’s branding, colors, and layout. We also offer free layout templates to help you with your designs. 

Q: How many synthetic menu copies can I order?

Orders for the synthetic menus start at 50 and you can order up to 5000 menus! 

Q: What’s the turnaround time for the menus?

Printing time for these is 9 business days, excluding weekends and holidays. The turnaround time also excludes shipping days.
